title: Cast Iron Chicken Fajitas
seoTitle: Cast Iron Chicken Fajitas | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Sizzling peppers and chicken with warm tortillas for ten
subtitle: Sizzling peppers and chicken with warm tortillas for ten
description: Chicken strips marinate in lime and spices, sear hot in cast iron with peppers and onions, and serve sizzling with warm tortillas and classic fixings. Built for build-your-own line speed.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.instruction: Toss chicken strips with lime juice, 2 tablespoons olive oil, chili powder, cumin, and garlic. Marinate at least 30 minutes in the fridge.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.instruction: Heat cast iron over high heat until smoking lightly. Sear chicken in batches 3–4 minutes until charred edges appear and internal temp reaches 165°F. Set aside.

steps.title: Char the vegetables
steps.instruction: Add remaining oil to the pan. Sear peppers and onions 4–5 minutes until blistered and tender-crisp with light char.

steps.title: Combine and season
steps.instruction: Return chicken to pan, toss with vegetables, and season with salt to taste. Squeeze half a lime over the mix.

steps.title: Serve sizzling
steps.instruction: Warm tortillas wrapped in foil at 300°F for 10 minutes. Portion chicken and peppers into hot cast iron skillets or hotel pans and serve with fixings. Target oven/smoker temperature: 300°F.

proTips: Vent the kitchen—high-heat searing sets off alarms if you are not ready.
A splash of chicken broth at the end keeps everything juicy on the hold line.
Offer sliced jalapeños for heat without forcing spice on the whole hall.
tonightSpread: Sizzling fajita pans with tortillas, shredded cheese, salsa, and sour cream.
Spanish rice on the side for crew who want a plated option instead of wraps.
leftovers: Chop into breakfast burritos with scrambled eggs and hot sauce.
Toss cold leftovers over romaine for a quick fajita salad lunch.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Fajitas feel like an event—sizzling pans, fresh toppings, everyone building their own. Interactive meals keep morale up on long tour days.
mealPrepNotes: Slice chicken uniform for even cooking. Marinate up to 8 hours. Warm tortillas in foil bundles so they stay soft at the line.
